dialogues.speaker: Message From a City Resident (IV)
dialogues.text: I was originally planning to take a pickaxe to the toytanium mountain, but it was too heavy...

dialogues.speaker: Message From a City Resident (IV)
dialogues.text: There aren't any good spots to hide things around here. How about somewhere near the <color=#00E2FFFF>seats in the station</color>?
